# Getting help with Pocket Polish

For topics, study mode, quizzes and saved progress, start with the [learner's guide](/README.md). For setup and firmware builds, see the [build guide](/docs/development/engineering/build-and-test.md).

Open this repository's **Issues** tab for questions, bugs and suggestions. Include the firmware version and board model for device issues, the buttons you pressed and what happened. For a course correction, include the topic, Polish phrase and suggested correction. Use the feature request or usage question template where applicable.

Report vulnerabilities through the [private reporting process](/.github/SECURITY.md). Remove personal information, credentials and private device links from attachments before sharing them.
